    .fall_z=-3,.style=&m4_style,.extra_bends=m4_bends,.extra_bend_count=2,
    .goal_box_plus_one=18,.goal_boxes_mask=0x000f8000u,.finish_rolls=true};
_Static_assert(sizeof(m4_boxes)/sizeof(*m4_boxes)<=R3_MAX_BOXES,"M4 box budget");
_Static_assert(sizeof(m4_faces)/sizeof(*m4_faces)<=R3_MAX_ART_FACES,"M4 art budget");
const r3_world_t *r3_m4_world(void){return &m4_scene;}
